answer: The delta schedule is applied in cedar and harbor reveals each instalment. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4573 identities would post 4708 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
